cases.name: Regina Rowe-Hicks
cases.about: Please send information about her life, dreams or interests to shecounted@gmail.com
cases.narrative: On 10/21/2001, her Chevy Camaro was found submerged in a pond along Section Line Road 30 in Willard, with her body inside. She had left her boyfriend house to pick up her son and never arrived. Police said Paul beat her unconscious, strapped her in the seat of her car, unrolled a window and pushed her car into a the pond.
